task_completion.description: Spawn a primitive shape at world coordinates (0.5, 0.0, 0.1) in CoppeliaSim.
task_completion.visual_evidence: CoppeliaSim scene hierarchy showing a new primitive object and the 3D view showing the object at the specified location.

task_completion.description: Attach a vision sensor with depth rendering to the robot arm's end-effector.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Scene hierarchy showing a 'Vision_sensor' object parented to the robot's tip/end-effector link.

task_completion.description: Capture depth buffers from at least 4 distinct joint configurations pointing at the target.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The robot arm shown in at least 4 different poses in the simulator, or terminal logs/scripts showing 4 distinct capture iterations.

task_completion.description: Save raw normalized depth values to /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/depth_view_<id>.csv.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File explorer or terminal 'ls' command showing depth_view_0.csv through depth_view_3.csv in the specified directory.

task_completion.description: Back-project depth pixels and save aggregated 3D points to merged_pointcloud.csv with specific columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A CSV file named 'merged_pointcloud.csv' containing columns: view_id, px, py, world_x, world_y, world_z.

task_completion.description: Save a metadata report (scanning_report.json) including sensor configurations and pose matrices.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A JSON file named 'scanning_report.json' open in an editor or listed in the exports folder containing resolution and matrix data.

integrity.description: Verify the agent interacted with the CoppeliaSim GUI or ZMQ API rather than just creating dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the CoppeliaSim application active, the robot moving, or the vision sensor floating view updating.

integrity.description: Ensure the point cloud was generated from sensor data, not manually typed.
integrity.visual_evidence: The merged_pointcloud.csv should contain a large number of points (at least 500) with floating point precision, which is difficult to fake manually.

integrity.description: Check that background points (depth 1.0) were filtered out of the final point cloud.
integrity.visual_evidence: The merged_pointcloud.csv should not contain world coordinates corresponding to the far clipping plane or depth values of 1.0.
